title: Countries
blurb: Capitals, flags, landmarks, and languages around the world.

hr.title: Zemlje svijeta
hr.blurb: Glavni gradovi, zastave, znamenitosti i jezici svijeta.

questions.q: Which country has the only national flag that is not a rectangle?
questions.fact: Nepal's flag is shaped like two stacked triangle pennants, with a moon in the top one and a sun in the bottom one.

hr.q: Koja zemlja ima jedinu nacionalnu zastavu koja nije pravokutna?
hr.fact: Nepalska zastava ima oblik dvaju trokutastih plamenaca jednog iznad drugog, s Mjesecom u gornjem i Suncem u donjem.

questions.q: True or false: Sydney is the capital of Australia.
questions.fact: The capital is Canberra, which was planned and built to be the capital. It officially took the job in 1927.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: Sydney je glavni grad Australije.
hr.fact: Glavni grad je Canberra, planirana i izgrađena baš da bude prijestolnica. Tu je ulogu službeno preuzela 1927.

questions.q: What is the smallest country in the world by area?
questions.fact: Vatican City covers just 44 hectares, about 110 acres. It sits entirely inside the city of Rome.

hr.q: Koja je najmanja zemlja na svijetu po površini?
hr.fact: Vatikan zauzima samo 44 hektara i cijeli se nalazi unutar grada Rima.

questions.q: The ancient city of Machu Picchu is in which country?
questions.fact: The Inca built Machu Picchu high in the Andes Mountains in the 1400s.

hr.q: U kojoj se zemlji nalazi drevni grad Machu Picchu?
hr.fact: Inke su Machu Picchu izgradile visoko u Andama u 15. stoljeću.

questions.q: In which city is the Eiffel Tower?
questions.fact: The Eiffel Tower was built for a world's fair in 1889. Many people back then thought it was ugly.

hr.q: U kojem se gradu nalazi Eiffelov toranj?
hr.fact: Eiffelov toranj izgrađen je za svjetsku izložbu 1889. Mnogi su tada mislili da je ružan.

questions.q: What is the main language spoken in Brazil?
questions.fact: Brazil has more Portuguese speakers than Portugal does, because it has far more people.

hr.q: Koji se jezik uglavnom govori u Brazilu?
hr.fact: U Brazilu ima više govornika portugalskog nego u Portugalu, jer Brazil ima mnogo više stanovnika.

questions.q: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.fact: Before Tokyo, the city of Kyoto was the home of Japan's emperors for more than 1,000 years.

hr.fact: Prije Tokija je Kyoto više od 1.000 godina bio dom japanskih careva.

questions.q: What is in the middle of Japan's flag?
questions.fact: The red circle stands for the sun. Japan's name is often translated as land of the rising sun.

hr.q: Što je u sredini japanske zastave?
hr.fact: Crveni krug predstavlja Sunce. Japan se često naziva zemljom izlazećeg sunca.

questions.q: Mount Everest sits on the border of Nepal and which country?
questions.fact: Everest's peak is the highest point above sea level on Earth.

hr.q: Mount Everest je na granici Nepala i koje zemlje?
hr.fact: Vrh Everesta najviša je točka iznad razine mora na Zemlji.

questions.q: Which leaf is on Canada's flag?
questions.fact: Maple trees also give Canada one of its famous foods, maple syrup.

hr.q: List kojeg je stabla na zastavi Kanade?
hr.fact: Javori Kanadi daju i jednu od njezinih slavnih namirnica, javorov sirup.
